title: 0007 修炼体系0008 半首诗
content_zh:
“这个嘛……老夫现在无法探查识海，不能准确判断。不过在香火融入全身时，洪先生可感觉到异象吗？”
殷云霄本能地就要去触碰洪涛的额头，可刚伸半截又缩回去了。他现在法力全无，连魂魄都被禁锢起来了，不再具备这种能力，只能改为别的方式。
“异象……大人稍后！”这下还真把洪涛问住了，他根本没赶上过香火进入识海融入全身，不知道是什么感觉。
原本的洪涛灵魂记忆中也不是事无巨细都有，况且现在还很虚弱，很多事情都想不起来了。不过也有办法，前天刚刚发过俸禄，自己的5份香火还在识海里未使用，正好拿来试试。
“呃……好像有股清流环绕全身皮肤，除了有些微痒并无不适感。”
按照之前洪涛记忆中的步骤，集中精神入定，操控识海里的香火神力顺脊柱上行百会，再下行会阴，仔细体会了下，好像没有特别清晰的感觉。
“此乃练皮之象，大体上需耗费3000份香火才能修成。具体数字并无一定之规，视天赋强弱会有些偏差。百多年来历代修士大致总结出了一套规律，虽不精准也能当做参考。”
其实洪涛还没描述完自身体感，殷云霄就捋着鼠须摇头晃脑了。看到对方还是一脸迷惑不解，就知道这位行刑力士对修行体系知之甚少。
这倒也不是什么怪事，修士相对普通人来讲还是比较少的，主要是一般人很难获得足够的香火提升品阶，自然不会了解太多。
但只要进入了仕途，或者在军中有所建树，这层窗户纸也就被捅破了。说起来修行者的体系并不复杂，大体和朝廷官制相仿，也有九品十八阶。
从九品开始，分别是淬体、内壮、通感、气动、刚柔、归元、灵台、坐忘、无垢九个大等级，也是最初的划分。
随着时间推移，为了更精准区分修士强弱以便于管理，又把每个等级细分成了上下两个阶段。
淬体、内壮、通感被称为下三品。处于这个阶段的修士主要体现在对身体的锤炼上，力量、敏捷和五识（眼、耳、鼻、舌、身）都要高于常人。
到了气动、刚柔、归元境界，就进入了中三品阶段。在筋骨皮肉和五识都得到极大提高的基础之上，又对第六识进行开发，也就是意识。
这玩意不再是单一的感官功能，而是综合性判断。殷云霄也无法用精准的字句描述，只是举了几个例子。比如记忆力、情绪控制、思考分析速度等等。
洪涛按照他的说法又自己定义了下，大致可以理解为大脑的运算能力。练完身体再升级锻炼大脑很合理，毕竟身体运动要靠大脑来指挥。
而到了灵台、坐忘、无垢的上三品阶段，理解起来就更加困难了，不是殷云霄讲的不清楚，而是洪涛自己缺乏这方面的常识。
上三品主要提高的是魂魄，讲究炼气还神、滋养魂魄、感悟天道。每个字都认识，组成词也识得，可就是不明白要说明什么。炼气是啥气？魂魄怎么体会？天道又是什么玩意呢？
最终洪涛只能先把这些东西理解为精神层面上的某种概括，才能在逻辑上说服自己。先练身体、再提高智商、最后就能进入多维世界玩心灵感应了，大致上说得通。
可要说信了吧，还真没有。洪涛属于死心眼那类的，不撞南墙不死心。无论有多少人认定的道理，只要自己没亲眼所见、亲耳所闻、亲身经历，就必须划个大大的问号。

不过他又具备搞学术研究的严谨性，对不曾证明过的东西也不会贸然否定，时刻遵循大胆假设小心求证的原则。
本着这个原则，他必须信一部分，因为在穿越过来的这些日子里不光看到、听到了很多违反现代常识的怪事，还亲身经历了。
比如坐在对面的猥琐老头，身体里就禁锢着另一个人的灵魂，而这个人还是死了很多年的。眼下他却在和自己侃侃而谈，时不时还端起酒杯来一口。
而且自己也确实亲身感受到了一点，那张不知道用什么东西写出来的符箓，里面确实蕴藏着某种说不出道不明的能量，也确实进入了自己大脑。只是数量有点少，影响不是很大，不仔细体会都感觉不到。
按照殷云霄的说法，只要能继续修炼融入香火神力身体就会越来越强健。直到融入3000份香火，大概率会完成练皮阶段，进入下一个境界，锻骨。
但3000份香火不是固定值，而是个中位数。根据自身天赋不同，有的人可能多点，有的人可能少点，误差不会太大。
一旦完成练皮阶段，成为九品下阶修士，就等于敲开了修行的大门，身体会随着香火神力的不断积累发生改变。
之后再吸纳5000份左右香火就能进入九品上阶锻骨期，进一步强化骨骼韧带，在继续提高力量耐力的同时，敏捷方面也会大幅增强。
在军队中能修行到锻骨期的士兵会成为精锐，单从个人战斗力上衡量，不管空手还是持械，一个人可以划拉三四个普通士兵。
完成锻骨，再吸收10000份香火可突破到八品内壮下阶，名曰生精。修行重点从筋骨皮转向更深层次，开始增强气血，最直接的表现就是使人精力旺盛。
再融入20000份香火神力，就到了八品内壮上阶脏腑期，修炼后五脏六腑皆可变强，基本上不再得病，对各种毒也有了抗性。
比如受了同样的伤，普通人可能马上死去，九品淬体修士可能伤及内脏成为废人，但有了八品上阶的修为，只要修养些时日就能恢复如初了。
从脏腑期再向上修炼，可以达到七品通感下阶明目期，需要的香火数量直接翻倍，达到了40000份，会使人耳聪目明五识敏锐。
之后再积累60000份香火则进入了七品上阶开窍期，修炼重点也从身体转向大脑，可以大幅提高记忆力和思维能力。
在整个大夏国内，九品修士的数量最多。因为不光军队里需要这样的人才充任弓手和下级军官，很多走科举仕途的人也会想尽办法积累香火走到这一步，毕竟考取功名更需要记忆力和思维能力。
而考取功名之后，文官们通常就不再修炼，因为他们需要用香火祭拜官印获得威压力，除非有特殊渠道获得额外数量的香火，一般而言无法再在修行上继续投入。
当然了，也有部分文官出身贫苦，没能力获取那么多香火。但他们天赋聪明，后天刻苦，也能一步步通过科举进入仕途。
七品上阶之后也是修士的分界线，要进入六品气动境需要12万份香火。对于绝大部分修士而言这是个天文数字，非一家一户能筹到，所以中品修士数量比较少。
至于说上三品修士更是凤毛麟角，而其身后往往都靠着某个大势力或者大家族，比如佛门、道门的高僧、高功，或者大世家子弟和军中高级将领。
“此法抑制了民间武力，对社会稳定有利。却也阻断了底层的上升通道，久而久之贫者恒贫、富者恒富，会养出很多门阀世家，让社会进入阶级固化。”

听完殷云霄对修行体系的介绍，洪涛首先想到的不是修行本身，而是由此造成的社会问题。同时也更加确定了这套体系的设计初衷，把权力具象化化。思路挺巧妙，效果嘛……知之甚少，暂时无法评价。
content_en:
"Well... I can't detect the sea of consciousness right now, and I can't make an accurate judgment. But when the incense melts into the body, can Mr. Hong feel anything strange?"
Yin Yunxiao instinctively wanted to touch Hong Tao's forehead, but he retracted as soon as he was halfway extended. He now has no magic power and even his soul is imprisoned. He no longer has this ability and can only use other methods.
"Vision... Sir, please wait a minute!" This really stopped Hong Tao from asking. He had never caught up with the incense entering the sea of ​​​​consciousness and integrating into his body. He didn't know what it felt like.
Hong Tao's original soul memory didn't have everything in detail, and besides, he was still very weak now and couldn't remember many things. But there is a way. I just received my salary the day before yesterday, and my five incense sticks are still unused in the sea of ​​consciousness, so I just want to try them out.
"Uh...it seems like there is a stream of clear water surrounding the skin all over the body. There is no discomfort except for some slight itching."
According to the previous steps in Hong Tao's memory, he concentrated his mind into meditation, controlled the power of the incense in the sea of ​​consciousness to go up the spine for a hundred times, and then down to the perineum. After careful experience, it seemed that there was no particularly clear feeling.
"This is the image of skin training. It generally requires 3,000 incense to be cultivated. There is no specific number, and there will be some deviations depending on the strength of the talent. Over the past hundred years, monks of all ages have roughly summarized a set of rules, which can be used as a reference even if it is not accurate."
In fact, before Hong Tao could finish describing his physical sensations, Yin Yunxiao was stroking his whiskers and shaking his head. Seeing that the other party still looked confused, he knew that this executioner knew very little about the practice system.
This is not a strange thing. There are still relatively few monks compared to ordinary people. The main reason is that it is difficult for ordinary people to obtain enough incense to improve their grades, so they naturally do not know much.
But as soon as he enters an official career or makes achievements in the military, this layer of window paper will be pierced. Speaking of which, the practitioner system is not complicated. It is roughly similar to the imperial official system, with nine grades and eighteen levels.
Starting from the ninth level, there are nine major levels: Body Tempering, Neizhuang, Synaesthesia, Qi Dynamic, Hard and Soft, Guiyuan, Lingtai, Zuowang, and Wugou, which are also the initial divisions.
As time went by, in order to more accurately distinguish the strength and weakness of monks for easier management, each level was subdivided into upper and lower stages.
Tempering the body, strengthening the body, and synaesthesia are called the lower three grades. Monks at this stage are mainly reflected in physical training, and their strength, agility and five senses (eyes, ears, nose, tongue, body) are higher than ordinary people.
When you reach the realm of pneumatic movement, hardness and softness, and return to the original state, you have entered the middle third stage. On the basis that the muscles, bones, skin, flesh, and five senses have been greatly improved, the sixth sense, that is, consciousness, has been developed.
This thing is no longer a single sensory function, but a comprehensive judgment. Yin Yunxiao couldn't describe it in precise words, but only gave a few examples. Such as memory, emotional control, thinking and analysis speed, etc.
Hong Tao defined it himself according to what he said, which can be roughly understood as the computing power of the brain. It makes sense to upgrade your brain after training your body. After all, body movements are directed by your brain.
But when it comes to the upper third-level stages of Lingtai, Zuowang, and Wugu, it becomes even more difficult to understand. It's not that Yin Yunxiao's explanation is unclear, but that Hong Tao himself lacks common sense in this area.
The main thing to improve in the third level is the soul, which focuses on refining Qi to restore the spirit, nourishing the soul, and understanding the way of heaven. I know every word and the constituent words, but I just don’t understand what it means. What is Qi refining? How does the soul feel? What is the way of heaven?
In the end, Hong Tao could only understand these things as some kind of generalization on the spiritual level before he could logically convince himself. It generally makes sense to train your body first, then improve your IQ, and finally you can enter the multidimensional world and play telepathy.
But if you have to believe it, there really isn’t. Hong Tao is a stubborn person who won't give up until he hits the wall. No matter how many people believe the truth, as long as youIf you haven’t seen it with your own eyes, heard it with your own ears, or experienced it yourself, you must draw a big question mark.
However, he possesses the rigor to engage in academic research and will not hastily deny anything that has not been proven. He always follows the principle of bold assumptions and careful verification.
Based on this principle, he must believe part of it, because during the days he traveled through time, he not only saw and heard many strange things that violated modern common sense, but also experienced them himself.
For example, the wretched old man sitting opposite has the soul of another person imprisoned in his body, and this person has been dead for many years. Right now, he was talking to himself, taking a sip from his wine glass from time to time.
And I did personally feel that the talisman written with something unknown did contain some kind of indescribable energy, and it did enter my brain. It's just that the quantity is a bit small, the impact is not very big, and you can't feel it unless you experience it carefully.
According to Yin Yunxiao, as long as he can continue to practice and integrate the divine power of incense, his body will become stronger and stronger. Until 3,000 portions of incense are incorporated, it will most likely complete the skin training stage and enter the next level, bone training.
But 3,000 incense is not a fixed value, but a median. Depending on their own talents, some people may have more, some may have less, and the error will not be too big.
Once you complete the skin training stage and become a ninth-grade lower-level monk, you have opened the door to practice, and your body will change with the continuous accumulation of incense and divine power.
After that, if you absorb about 5,000 more incense, you can enter the ninth-level upper-level bone forging stage, which will further strengthen the bone and ligaments. While continuing to improve your strength and endurance, your agility will also be greatly enhanced.
In the army, soldiers who can practice to the bone forging stage will become elites. Measuring their personal combat effectiveness alone, one person can pull down three or four ordinary soldiers regardless of whether they are empty-handed or armed.
After completing the bone forging and absorbing 10,000 more incense, you can break through to the lower level of eighth-grade inner strength, which is called producing essence. The focus of practice shifts from muscles, bones and skin to deeper levels and begins to strengthen qi and blood. The most direct manifestation is to make people energetic.
After incorporating another 20,000 portions of the divine power of incense, you will reach the stage of strengthening the upper-level internal organs of the eighth level. After practice, all the internal organs will become stronger, and you will basically no longer get sick, and you will also become resistant to various poisons.
For example, if an ordinary person suffers the same injury, he or she may die immediately, while a ninth-grade body-tempering monk may injure his internal organs and become a cripple. However, with an upper-level eighth-grade cultivation, he can recover as before as long as he cultivates for a while.
By practicing from the viscera stage and up, you can reach the lower stage of seventh-grade synaesthesia, the eyesight-brightening stage. The amount of incense required is directly doubled to 40,000, which will make people's ears sharp, eyesight and five senses sharp.
After accumulating 60,000 more incense, you will enter the seventh-level upper-level awakening stage. The focus of cultivation will also shift from the body to the brain, which can greatly improve memory and thinking ability.
In the entire country of Daxia, the number of ninth-grade monks is the largest. Because not only the army needs such talents to serve as archers and lower-level officers, but many people who take the imperial examination career will also try their best to accumulate incense and get to this point. After all, taking the exam requires memory and thinking ability.
After obtaining the title, civil servants usually stop practicing because they need to use incense to worship the official seal to gain pressure. Unless there are special channels to obtain additional amounts of incense, generally speaking, they cannot continue to invest in practice.
Of course, there are also some civil servants who come from poor backgrounds and are unable to obtain so much incense. But they were talented and smart, and worked hard, and they were able to enter official careers through the imperial examination step by step.
After reaching the seventh level, it is also the dividing line for monks. To enter the sixth level of Qi Dynasty, 120,000 incense is required. For most monks, this is an astronomical figure and cannot be raised by one household, so the number of middle-grade monks is relatively small.
As for upper-level third-level monks, they are even rarer, and they are often backed by some big force or family., such as eminent monks and high-level practitioners from Buddhist and Taoist sects, or children of great families and senior military generals.
"This method suppresses civil force and is beneficial to social stability. However, it also blocks the upward path of the lower class. Over time, the poor will remain poor and the rich will remain rich. It will breed many aristocratic families and make society solidify into classes."
After listening to Yin Yunxiao's introduction to the practice system, the first thing Hong Tao thought of was not the practice itself, but the social problems caused by it. At the same time, it also confirmed the original design intention of this system and made power concrete. The idea is quite clever, but the effect... I don't know much about it, so I can't evaluate it yet.
